notes.title: DESOLATE: CC will be gone from Steam
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, sorry to say that I'll be taking this game off of Steam. I can't give too many details on why but in the future I would look out for anything involving these characters and the world they are in!

For anyone who has bought the product; thanks for your support!

notes.title: PRICE NOW $1.99!
notes.notes: Like I said in Endurance; I would lower the price of this game as soon as I was able to. Now hopefully the games price reflects more on the games quality and length.
